title: yaks fleet keyword vocabulary
description: Keywords that belong to the fleet's own vocabulary LAYER, not the core meta-model. A vocab file may declare and carry these, but their behavior is a later package's job — @yaks/vocab records the declaration and interrogates it, nothing more. `prefix` has moved out to @yaks/id (packages/id/meta/id.vocab.json); this file holds what is still homeless.
$comment: Split out on purpose: a customer app composes the core vocabulary and typically NOT this one. Modelled, carried, but its handler is deferred.

by_name.description: true = this kind's doc title is a name a caller can type (resolved to the entity). Deferred handler.
